unit_selection.primary: all source VISp clusters; no QC or response filter
unit_selection.ordering: original source row order; IDs never renumbered

presentations.blank_rule: missing orientation; temporal_frequency may also be missing
presentations.temporal_frequency: all finite positive source levels, ascending
presentations.support: every direction x temporal-frequency cell nonempty
presentations.duration: original stop_time minus start_time; finite and positive

invalid_intervals.policy: fail if any source invalid interval overlaps a selected stimulus window; also baseline windows if QC requested; do not drop units or presentations

responses.rate: integer count divided by actual presentation duration

osi.preferred_tf: largest single-direction condition mean across each TF
osi.folding: equal mean of opposite-direction condition means
osi.preference_data: same trials as reported responses; descriptive only

optional_qc.missing_metrics: retain primary unit, blank unavailable metrics, qc_pass=false
optional_qc.empty_denominator: null fraction; zero numerator and denominator
